title: PortPilot Build Evidence
description: Emitted by port-migration. The measured before/after evidence for a port: every command actually run, its exit code, and whether it was executed or merely cross-compiled. Consumed by port-review and the orchestrator's build gate. The central rule this contract enforces is that a cross-compiled artifact is NEVER evidence that anything ran - 'mode' must say so, and arm64Execution must be disclosed either way.

baseline.description: Measured on the UNMODIFIED source, before any task ran. Without this the 'after' numbers prove nothing.

after.description: Measured after migration. Must cover the same ground as baseline plus the required Windows gates.

arm64Execution.description: Mandatory disclosure. Cross-compiling for Arm64 does not satisfy the Arm64 gate; if nothing was executed on Arm64 hardware, that must be stated here rather than left implied by silence.

reason.description: Required when executed is false: why no Arm64 execution happened.

testSuites.description: Per-suite measured results. A workflow-level success cannot hide continue-on-error or a summary step that failed to propagate a test process exit code.

requiredTestSuites.description: Complete suite manifest derived from the project graph and plan. testSuites must match this set exactly.

regressionChecks.description: Evidence that the ORIGINAL platforms still build and lint. A port that greens Windows by breaking Linux is a failed port, and host-only linting cannot detect it.

toolchain.description: Resolved compiler identity evidence. Required semantically before a run may pass so dependency restore and project compilation cannot silently use different MSVC installations.

command.description: The literal command line run. Not a paraphrase - a reviewer must be able to paste and re-run it.

target.description: Triple or host label, e.g. aarch64-pc-windows-msvc, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, host-x64.

mode.description: executed = the command ran to completion on this machine. cross-compiled-not-executed = an artifact was produced for a target that was never run. skipped = not attempted.
